name: Dragon Adventures
creator: Sonar Studios
redeem: Launch Dragon Adventures on Roblox and finish the tutorial if you are new.
Press the Rewards button on the right side of the screen, or open the Menu in the bottom right and pick Rewards (this tab used to be called Gift Codes).
Type a code into the box at the bottom of the Rewards window.
Press Redeem! and the potion is sent to your inventory.
notes:
Dragon Adventures is a dragon-taming RPG from Sonar Studios. You find and hatch eggs, raise baby dragons into adults, and ride them around several open worlds while collecting food and resources. There are more than 200 dragon species to discover, and you can build your own lair to keep them in, fight enemies, and fly or run across each map.

Most codes give potions, food, coins or event items, and they usually only last about a week. The five working right now are YouTuber codes that each give a preset potion, which recolors a dragon in that creator's color style, and these do not expire. Use them on a dragon you plan to keep. New limited codes usually come from Sonar Studios on X and Instagram during events, birthdays and big updates.

faq.q: Where did the Gift Codes button go in Dragon Adventures?
faq.a: In November 2025 the Gift Codes tab was renamed to Rewards. You can open it from the Menu or from the Rewards button on the right side of the screen.
No, the game accepts codes in any mix of capital and lowercase letters. Each code still only works once per account.

faq.q: Why do so many Dragon Adventures codes stop working fast?
faq.a: Event and milestone codes from Sonar Studios normally expire after about a week. Only the content creator preset potion codes stay active long term, so redeem event codes as soon as you see them.

tips: Feed your baby dragon often. Dragons grow up over time with care, and an adult dragon is much more useful for riding and fighting.
Gather resources like food and building materials as you explore. You need them to look after your dragons and build up your lair.
Keep an eye out for eggs in every world you visit. Hatching new species is how your collection grows, and there are over 200 to find.
Build your lair a little at a time. Starting small and adding pieces as you gather materials is easier than planning a huge base all at once.
useRewards: Each working code gives one preset potion that recolors a dragon in a creator's style, and a potion is used up on one dragon. Save them for a species you plan to keep long term rather than a dragon you might trade or replace. Limited event codes have given potions, food and coins in the past, so redeem those the day you see them.
codeChannels: Sonar Studios on X (@Sonar_Games) and Instagram, plus the Dragon Adventures Discord server
